purpose: the per-book lens evidence OW-19 requires and close-gate item 12's OW-6c packet owes: what review each book actually received, what shape any later lens took, and what that lens found.

headline_finding.statement: every early-book scope where a second lens was eventually applied to rows a single lane had already passed found a finding in the large majority of rows: 91% of Isaiah's audited rows, 88% across the five wisdom books, 97% of the Proverbs cluster rows.
headline_finding.comparison: Ezekiel's own dual-blind round, run with two blind lanes at full coverage, drew a challenge from at least one lane on 131 of 145 rows - 90%. Two different review designs, on different books, land in the same order of magnitude.
headline_finding.what_it_supports: OW-19's floor, on measured grounds rather than principle: when a second lens looks at single-lane work, it finds something in roughly nine rows out of ten.
headline_finding.what_it_does_NOT_support: it does NOT show that nine in ten boundaries are wrong. 'A finding' counts any severity and most are low or medium; highs are rare (8, 5 and 4 respectively). Nor is an audit's hit rate directly comparable to a blind lane's - an audit is commissioned to find defects and reads the answer first, which biases it upward. Both figures are reported so the comparison can be argued with rather than taken.
headline_finding.tier: MEASURED for every count; the comparison between the two designs is INFERRED

OW19_shapes_applied.RETROFIT-REDERIVE: the added lane never sees the shipped rows; COUNTS as a blind lane
OW19_shapes_applied.RETROFIT-AUDIT: the added lane reads the shipped rows; does NOT count, and the book stays single-lane-plus-audit
OW19_shapes_applied.finding: all three early-book scopes below are RETROFIT-AUDIT. None of these books is dual-lensed.

honest_limits: Whether any early book had a SECOND blind primary lane is UNKNOWN from these three receipts. They establish that Isaiah's lane was named 'LF-primary', which implies a lane naming scheme, and nothing more. Do not read UNKNOWN as 'no'.
These three scopes are the audits that were RUN. A book absent from this file is not thereby a book that was reviewed once - it is a book with no evidence in the artifacts read here.
Defect densities are per ROW and count any severity. They are not comparable to a boundary error rate.
The five-book audit's own receipt records 5 scope-id collisions resolving 213 ids to 208 rows. The smaller number is used here; the receipt carries the collisions.
